headline: Executive order from President Obama sets guidelines for how federal agencies write and review regulations.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Obama, deals with how federal agencies create rules and review them. Its title says it aims to improve the regulation process and the review of regulations. No summary was provided, so the specific requirements cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to follow the order's guidelines when making and reviewing rules.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses and individuals who must follow federal rules
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected by changes in how federal rules are written or reviewed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 18, 2011; no separate effective date was provided.
